original_test_intent: Verify each SMBIOS Type 4 L1 Cache Handle is the approved no-cache-information sentinel or resolves to the correct Type 7 L1 cache record for that processor, and that the relationship remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw and decoded Type 4 and Type 7 structures, bind processors by socket/handle, resolve each non-sentinel L1 handle to exactly one Type 7 record, validate its cache level/type/topology against the platform recipe, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves the expected processor-to-L1 topology, allowed sentinel/shared relationships and reboot plan. Handle resolution and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Policy for shared versus private L1 Type 7 records and duplicate references
Validated complete Type 4/Type 7 parser with raw-byte retention
Approved reboot, service-impact and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS collection; do not change cache, CPU, BIOS or firmware settings.
Preserve complete Type 4 and Type 7 raw/decoded records; a handle string alone cannot demonstrate a valid target.
Resolve every non-sentinel handle to exactly one existing Type 7 structure and verify it represents the intended L1 cache relationship.
Do not call a shared or absent relationship defective without the platform's approved topology and sentinel policy.
Stop on dangling/wrong-type/ambiguous handles, unexpected topology drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete Type 4/Type 7 data, map processors, resolve each L1 handle or sentinel, validate referential integrity and approved topology before/after reboot.
Do not alter cache state, fabricate missing Type 7 targets or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve expected L1 topology and sentinel/shared-cache policy.
Approve reboot/recovery and decide the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep suppresses errors and cannot establish that a non-sentinel handle resolves to the correct Type 7 structure.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 4 and Type 7 structures, resolve L1 handles by numeric value and validate target type, cache level and socket topology.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The L1 Cache Handle scope, Type 4 script and 10/10-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a handle-indexed SMBIOS graph, treat the defined sentinel explicitly, resolve every other Type 4 L1 reference to one Type 7 record and validate L1 attributes/topology before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, CPU/cache topology and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 4 cache-handle and Type 7 cache-information semantics, approved platform topology and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Converts a label check into a referential-integrity and topology check while preserving the original field.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage by proving the referenced record exists and is the intended L1 cache.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS cache representation can aggregate or omit implementation detail; it should not be replaced with OS cache enumeration without an approved mapping.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a sentinel, one Type 7 record per processor, or documented shared references; the override must define exact topology and may not treat an OS cache listing as a substitute for the SMBIOS link.
expected_evidence: Approved L1 topology, sentinel/shared policy and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 4 and Type 7 raw/decoded inventory with a handle-resolution table
Evidence that every non-sentinel target exists, is Type 7 and has approved L1 attributes
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot graph comparison
Engineer verdict with any accepted topology exception

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item consistently identifies the L1 handle; the generic criteria require correctness and persistence, which include referential integrity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Complete Type 4/Type 7 metadata can be read safely; missing topology policy is readiness input.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds Type 7 target resolution, sentinel handling and cache-level/topology validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps the correct relationship model while changing the capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under V3.1 and separating engineer verdict from execution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Requires a handle graph and raw provenance rather than trusting one decoded line.

review_improvement: Detects dangling, wrong-type and wrong-level references that a grep-only value comparison would miss.
independent_technical_reasoning: With an approved cache topology, collection, handle resolution, target validation and reboot comparison are deterministic software operations.
